resources.string: Understand the risk behind every URL

High impact checks:
 • Raw IP address → +45
 • @ symbol in URL → +40
 • Homoglyph / look-alike characters → +45
 • Typosquatting of known brands → +40
 • TLD in subdomain → +35


Medium impact checks:
 • Suspicious TLD → +30
 • URL shortener service → +30
 • High domain entropy → +18–30
 • Excessive subdomains → +10–25
 • Brand impersonation → +25
 • Non-standard port → +20
 • No HTTPS → +20


Lower impact checks:
 • Many special characters → +10–20
 • Suspicious keywords → +15
 • High digit ratio → +15
 • Very long URL → +15
Argus Eye helps you stay safe online by analyzing URLs and identifying potential threats. It explains why a link may be risky, so you can make informed decisions before opening it.

• URL risk analysis in real time
 • Multiple risk factor detection
 • Clear visual and text-based warnings
